test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some moons are stars.

Some stars are planets.

**Conclusions:**

(I): All stars are moons.

(II): Some moons are planets.
solution:
**Given Statements:**

Some moons are stars.

Some stars are planets.

**Venn Diagram Representation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/562a8664606eba0fc13db48751f92cad7cf1191f88162ebce6767b8c545c4b6c.png] 

**Conclusions:**

**(I) All stars are moons:** **Does not follows**( because, the statement says only **some moons are stars **and It does not mean all stars are moons.)

**(II) Some moons are planets:** **Does not follows **( because, Some moons are stars and some stars are planets.But there is no definite relation given between moons and planets.)

∴ Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows."**
